Fehu — Rune Meaning

← All rune meanings
ᚠ
money abundance opportunity good start

Upright meaning

Good news — Fehu is basically the abundance rune, and it's showing up right when you need it. Think of it as a green light for anything money-related or resource-related in your life. Things could be picking up financially, or an opportunity might be heading your way that you'd be daft to pass up.

The key here is to stay open. Don't dismiss what's coming because it doesn't look exactly how you expected. Wealth comes in different forms — sometimes it's cash, sometimes it's creative energy, a useful connection, or a door that finally opens.

One thing Fehu is big on: sharing. Hoarding what you have doesn't serve you — what flows out tends to come back multiplied. Be generous where you can.

This is also a great rune for new starts. If you've been thinking about launching something — a project, a business, a relationship, a new habit — the energy right now is in your favour. Get moving while the momentum is there.

Reversed meaning

Fehu reversed is a nudge to check in with how things are flowing financially or resource-wise, because something might be off. Maybe money is tighter than expected, a plan hasn't paid off, or you're spreading yourself too thin.

Ask yourself honestly: are you holding on too tight out of fear? Or maybe the opposite — spending or giving without keeping enough back for yourself?

Either way, this isn't a great time to kick off something new. Better to pause, take stock, and figure out where the leak is before pouring more in. Once you understand what's going wrong, you can fix it.
